draft.subject: Getting River Labs' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

I know launch weeks get busy, so I'll keep this short. You haven't set up a first project yet, and that's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield does for River Labs -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to walk through it with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
